title: EPUB HTML sanitizer leaves executable URL and event-handler surfaces
reasoning: Article HTML crosses from remote feed content into generated XHTML. The sanitizer removes only three event-handler attributes and does not validate href/src schemes, so attributes like onmouseover or javascript: links can remain in the EPUB content or source link. The clearAttributes call also removes safe attributes from elements that happen to contain one of the three selected handlers, which can break legitimate links and images instead of precisely removing unsafe attributes.
recommendation: Use an explicit safelist-based sanitizer for EPUB XHTML. Strip all attributes whose names start with on, restrict URL-bearing attributes to safe schemes such as http/https/mailto, and sanitize article.originalUrl before emitting it into href.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included title-escaping test builds a separate helper Book rather than invoking EpubGenerator.sanitizeHtmlToXhtml, and it does not cover article content attributes or URL schemes.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests that generate an EPUB from content containing onmouseover, onclick plus href, and javascript: URLs; assert unsafe attributes/schemes are removed while safe href/src attributes remain.
